name: ink-fill
title: Ink Fill
description: A statement starts in the muted colour and fills with ink word by word as the reader scrolls through it.

meta.reducedMotion: The whole statement is in ink from the start.
meta.useWhen: Manifestos, about statements, a single paragraph that is the page's idea.
meta.avoidWhen: More than one per page; text the reader needs before scrolling (it must stay readable when muted).
